keyFindings.description: Gate picks its port from 20000-29999 on the stated ground that a :0 port comes from 32768-60999 and nothing in that range is allocated on its own. In this gVisor worker pod /proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_local_port_range is '16000 65535', and 401 of 2000 :0 binds landed in 20000-29999. While the gate is closed its port is free, and reconnect_err_test.go:138-139 restarts the server (fresh :0 client and monitoring listeners, nats.go:476-479) before gate.Open(), as do concurrent test binaries; a bind that lands on the gate's port makes Open fail with EADDRINUSE or the warning waits time out. Rare per run (about 1 in 25,000 for the restart's own two binds, more with concurrent packages) and loud rather than vacuous, but the invariant the code states is false on the surface this issue exists for. Fix: choose the gate's port below the low bound of the effective ephemeral range read from /proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_local_port_range (or a fixed range below 16000 with the comment naming both Linux's and gVisor's ranges), and correct the comment.

relay.Close's comment says it ends the copies in flight; it closes the listener and releases frozen waits, while unfrozen copies run until an endpoint ends, which Gate.Close's own comment (726-729) states correctly. Align the comment.
